primary_sources.title: Janasz–Pokora, On homological properties of some Cynk–Szemberg octic hyperplane arrangements
primary_sources.version_or_status: Full arXiv v4 PDF, revision 14 January 2026, retrieved. Journal citation: J. Korean Math. Soc.63(4) (2026), 753–771; DOI 10.4134/JKMS.j250358. PDF internal date 15 January 2026 differs from 24 August 2026 observed by Root in HTML; neither used as disclosure date.
primary_sources.inspection_scope: All substantive sections of the full primary text read, including all fourteen rigid equations, Proposition 4.1, Theorem 5.1 and Section 6. All fourteen rigid equations independently checked with exact modular nonvanishing certificates.
primary_sources.overlap_assessment: Generic binary and ternary linear-syzygy spaces vanish for each rigid example; binary Hilbert–Burch shifts (2,2,3) give cutoff 9, and ternary maximal ranks exclude generators involving the third variable before 9. This is an exact exclusion independent of factor count or title. Nonfreeness/type theorems alone do not imply the target failure.
primary_sources.remaining_gap: No exhaustive computation of the 63 one-parameter families, all admissible values of family 266, or every degeneration. No global exclusion claim. Final journal PDF not retrieved; inspected source is explicitly arXiv v4.
